text:
sre-oncall-bot: Incident detected: Helios Data (dedicated) — repeated VPC peering flaps causing control-plane isolation and elevated DB latency. Auto-created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4987 :rotating_light:
maya: saw the alert, digging into peering logs now. any recent config changes on peering router?
devon: nothing from config mgmt. last commit to peering terraform 2 days ago by @raj
alice: copying notes from postmortem call: problem appears similar to previous onprem peering flaps in March. recurrence window ~2w
raj: looking at router syslogs, there's intermittent BGP reset every ~20m. pushing logs to /tmp/helios-bgp.log
maya: can you paste tail?
raj: ```
Mar 03 10:14:12 bgpd[1234]: neighbor 10.2.1.1 reset (keepalive)
Mar 03 10:34:12 bgpd[1234]: neighbor 10.2.1.1 reset (keepalive)
```
emily: that's consistent with a flapping peer, may cause route withdrawal => peering route to DB tier momentarily unreachable. we should mark as P1? :warning:
sre-oncall-bot: Linked ticket INF-4987 -> INF-4992 (customer isolation runbook update)
maya: propose action items: 1) raj to validate physical router, 2) devops to add monitoring for BGP flaps (alert threshold 3 resets/15m), 3) eng-runtime to add automatic fallback to secondary peering path. owners: raj/devon/maya. timeline: 72h for hotfix, 2w for runbook + tests
devon: I'll own alerting, will open INF-4993 and attach Grafana dashboard. ETA 24h
raj: contacting Helios network team, will escalate if hardware. ETA 12h
alice: eng-runtime: can we simulate route withdrawal in staging to validate graceful fallback? @mike-runtime FYI
maya: also add regression test in dedicated e2e: simulate on-prem route flaps during rolling update
emily: note: we saw an isolation bug where tenant metrics from cached KV were not evicted when peering lost, causing cross-tenant noise. need a small fix in cache invalidation code.
devon: good catch — assign to eng-runtime, INF-4994. timeline 5d for patch + canary
maya: action tracker: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/helios-dedicated-remediation (I'll update)
alice: schedule follow-up in 48h to validate hotfix progress. repeating check-ins weekly for 4 weeks.
raj: ack, I'll paste router vendor ticket #12345 here when created
emily: +1. Also will add metric for 'tenant_kv_evictions' and alert on failure rate >0.1% per hour
sre-oncall-bot: incident status changed to 'action_required' — owners assigned: raj, devon, eng-runtime
maya: thanks all. closing thread for now, will reopen with updates or new infra findings :thumbsup:
